negate_rule.zh: negate: true 把这一项（或整组）取反：不满足它的才算命中。条件自带判法时（如冲煞生肖的 mode：without = 不冲所选肖，缺省；with = 冲所选肖）先按判法读，再看 negate——「避开冲马」写 mode 缺省、不加 negate；两者都加等于双重否定。连接词 joiner 写在后一项上，从上到下依次结合（A 或 B 且 C = (A 或 B) 且 C）。
negate_rule.en: negate: true inverts a leaf (or a whole group): it matches only where the condition fails. When a condition has its own mode (e.g. chong_shengxiao mode: without = the day does not clash the chosen signs, the default; with = it does), read the mode first, then negate — to avoid days clashing 马 keep the default mode and no negate; using both is a double negative. A joiner sits on the later item and items combine top to bottom (A OR B AND C = (A OR B) AND C).
